integrity: Proof includes exact quantifiers for every factor length and every integer valuation, with a reproducible standard-library finite checker. Computations corroborate only bounded cases. No independent audit or third-party mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The construction concerns one aperiodic ternary 2-automatic word, not uniformly recurrent words, arbitrary real valuations, or a classification of automatic sequences. The full abelian-complexity function is not computed. The positive lower-bound slope depends on the integer weights. Priority comparison cannot exclude unpublished or unindexed equivalent results.
title: Unavoidable linear valuation loss in a ternary \(2\)-automatic word
